title: Joining two modeled learning segments
description: You can read how the synthetic redesign example restarts its trial index.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: before uses the initial slice of trial values in the existing power-law formula. You retain that segment before constructing the second one.

steps.question: Does the after segment continue the original trial indices?
steps.answer: No. Its arange starts at one, restarting the power-law input for that segment.

steps.description: You concatenate before and after, then multiply by random factors. The result is a synthetic disrupted series rather than newly collected observations.
You plot the combined series and mark the segment boundary with a vertical line. The supplied recording contains no rendered plot or text output.
